audit.action: a better source should be cited for the same classification
audit.reasoning: The classification (fixed-dominant, penultimate penultimate stress) rests on the best available description, a 2012 669-page reference grammar with a phonology chapter, and the deciding quotation is verbatim at sec. 2.3 p. 79 of the PDF now obtained; the author's 2010 AALL phonological sketch says the same. No instrumental or competing description exists (author states correlates unmeasured). Record fields are under-filled rather than wrong: 'quote'/'cite'/'loc'/'grade' are empty at top level (quote lives only in 'sources'), locator lacks a page, and domain is 'not yet coded' although the source specifies it (penult of the phonological word = host + enclitic; nominalizer =ke and S-agreement enclitics shift stress to host-final). Suggested: fill cite/loc with 'Nagaya 2012, sec. 2.3, p. 79', add Nagaya 2010 sec. 4 as corroboration, set an strength of the evidence, and code domain = phonological word incl. enclitics. Optio

sources.quote: 'Stress in Lamaholot regularly falls on the penultimate syllable of a word, unless the word is monosyllabic, in which case it falls on the only syllable of the word.
